_note: The zetetic memory MCP server is a lightweight tool, not a primary service. Two bugs were found in the source repo's .mcp.json and are fixed here: (1) args used relative path 'tools/memory-mcp-server.py' with no ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} anchor — fixed with bash -c wrapper; (2) env used ${MEMORY_AGENT_ID:-unknown} which is broken syntax per cf85cfc — Claude Code only expands ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, so arbitrary env-var fallback expressions are passed literally. Fixed by removing the fallback and using a plain string default.
